description.en: Sets or clears a temporary bit flag. Without a second argument the flag is set. Temporary bit flags are a separate table of 128 bits (numbers 0 to 127) in the flag data, used by the system scripts for short-lived states (by the name; when they are cleared was not traced). A number outside that range makes the game report an error, and the bit is still written past the table.
true to set the flag, false to clear it.

true (also when the flag data is not available and nothing is written).
null if the script system is not ready or no argument is given.

examples.case: The rest area marks its dialogue (real usage, from ie4_ev_sub_heal.nut)
